Designs and runs the data system that captures feedstock, production, quality, and end-use data to the standard required by the external verifier. Owns HSE programme design, training, documentation, and audit readiness. Serves as the primary interface with external verifiers, auditors, and regulators (NEMA, DOSH, third-party carbon verifiers). Reports to the Biochar Lead.

## **Responsibilities**

Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Leadership

- Design and maintain the facility's HSE programme, including risk registers, emergency response plans, and safety-critical procedures
- Design and deliver HSE training for all facility staff, including inductions, toolbox talks, and emergency drills
- Ensure PPE distribution, safety signage, and site safety infrastructure are in place and maintained
- Support the Production Shift Supervisors, who carry shift-level safety accountability, with the programme, tools, and training they need to enforce safety on shift.
- Coordinate scheduled third-party HSE testing and audits (fire safety, emissions, occupational health)

Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification (MRV) Leadership

- Design, implement, and manage the facility's MRV system covering feedstock inputs, production outputs, quality measurements, and carbon removal calculations.
- Ensure data collection processes across all shifts are accurate, consistent, and traceable to the carbon standards the facility reports against
- Oversee and support the Lab and Quality Technicians in their data recording responsibilities to ensure the standard required for verification
- Develop and maintain data management systems, dashboards, and reporting templates for MRV purposes
- Stay current on evolving carbon standards, methodology requirements, and MRV best practices in the biochar sector

Audit Readiness

- Serve as the primary point of contact with external verifiers, auditors, and certification bodies during verification and audit cycles (carbon, HSE, environmental)
- Prepare and submit monthly and quarterly reports required for carbon credit verification
- Prepare the facility for audits, including documents, site walkthroughs, and evidence for the verifier
- When auditors flag issues, own the corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) through to closure
- Maintain audit-ready documentation across MRV, HSE, and environmental compliance streams at all times

Staff Training

- Train all relevant staff at the facility on MRV data recording requirements, HSE procedures, and the importance of data and safety discipline
- Coordinate cross-functionally with Production, Quality, and Administration on the completeness and accuracy of the data they record for MRV and safety reporting

Farmer Engagement

- Develop and maintain training materials for field staff on correct biochar application methods and how to collect data at the point of delivery
- Deliver refresher training to field teams before the start of each season

## **Career Growth and Development**

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You'll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You'll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

Across all roles, these are the [general qualifications we look for](https://oneacrefund.org/work-with-us/application-process/qualifications/). For this role specifically, you will have:

- Minimum 3 years of experience in HSE, compliance, audit, or environmental data management roles
- Strong background in HSE, OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Act, Kenya, 2007), ISO (International Organization for Standardization), or comparable regulatory environments is a strong advantage
- Comfort engaging with third-party auditors and external verifiers, and comfort designing and running audit-facing programmes
- Familiarity with carbon standards (e.g., Isometric, Puro.earth, EBC, IBI) or carbon credit methodologies is a plus but not required. Successful candidates will build this expertise on the job, supported by Tupande's carbon partners
- Strong data management, reporting, and analytical skills

- High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data integrity, traceability, and safety discipline

**Position duration: ASAP until January 30, 2028**

**Note: this is a remote position, and relocation is not being offered.**

**Project Overview:**

Catholic Relief Services is implementing a global emergency response initiative designed to deliver timely, life‑saving humanitarian assistance in rapidly evolving crises worldwide. This program will enable fast, flexible action to address urgent needs arising from sudden shocks and protracted emergencies. It supports critical humanitarian sectors through context‑appropriate assistance while emphasizing operational readiness, rapid response activation, locally led implementation, accountability to affected communities, and safe, dignified programming. The initiative strengthens the organization’s ability to respond at speed and scale in complex and resource‑constrained environments, ensuring help reaches people most in need when it matters most.

**Job Summary**

You will provide technical advice and support to a range of program design and implementation issues in the area of Shelter and Settlements in line with Catholic Relief Services (CRS) program quality principles and standards, donor guidelines, and industry best practices to Country Program (CP) teams to advance the delivery of high-quality programming to the poor and vulnerable. Your advice, knowledge, and support will contribute to determining how effective, adaptive and innovative CRS’ Shelter and Settlements programming is across the globe.

**Roles and Key Responsibilities**

- Support the development and contribute to the implementation of agency-wide strategies, standards, tools and best practices in Shelter and Settlements that effectively engage partners, donors, and governments. Help ensure a cross-sectoral approach integrating gender, protection mainstreaming, and disaster risk reduction.
- Provide technical solutions to CP teams, remotely and on-site, for strategic planning and how to best apply standards, best practices, partnership principles, tools and M&E, helping to ensure high-quality implementation.

As needed, act as a technical writer on proposal development teams. Advise project teams on integrating donor strategies, priorities and technical requirements into CRS’ approach.

- Collect and analyze program data, capture and share lessons learned and best practices for specific projects to facilitate improvements in decision-making and contribute to the Shelter and Settlements learning agenda.

***Knowledge, Skills and Abilities***

Salary and Benefits packages for successful candidates employed outside the U.S. are based on the country of employment/in-country office where the candidate will perform the role. Start Date: 3Q 2026

## **About the Myanmar Programme at People in Need**

People in Need (PIN) is an international, non-profit organization providing humanitarian and development assistance around the world. In Myanmar, People in Need started to work in 2002, when it launched the financial assistance to civil society groups and provided humanitarian response to people affected by Cyclone Nargis in 2008. PIN supports local civil society partners with focus on strengthening local civil society organizations and providing them with the necessary knowledge and funding. Through humanitarian response, development and education projects and community cohesion-building programmes tailored to local conditions, and by working closely with local actors, PIN helps local communities cope with both waters induced disasters and human-made crises.

## **Position Summary**

As a member of the Country Management Team (together with Country Director, Head of Systems & Operations, Head of Operations, Head of Finance and Deputy Country Director), the Head of Programmes will jointly ensure the programme management and development of the country programme. The Head of Programmes supervises all projects under country programme , with the specific responsibility for the timely and efficient programme implementation, and most importantly the quality of projects and programmes in terms of their impact. By supervising the implementation of results-based M&E systems, the Head of Programmes also guides the programme strategy and development of future programmes. Together with the Country Director, the Head of Programmes represents PIN to donors and partners, ensuring that PIN is recognised for its thematic expertise, localization work and field experience.  
Furthermore, the Head of Programmes engages in medium and long-term planning and strategy activities, ensures continuous quality improvement of programmes and contributes towards a successful environment for the programme staff.

## **Duties & Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Leadership**

**Senior Management:**

- Lead the programme side of the development and implementation of the Country Strategic Plan, work plan and Country Programme review.
- Ensure that the overall programme is designed, managed and implemented in conformity to PIN policies, strategy and guidelines.
- Ensure development and adherence to Programme Risk Matrix with reference to country context.
- Lead the development and implementation of fundraising strategy and work plan with support of CD and HQ Funding Unit.
- Supports in Strategic Partnership engagement and building stronger relationships between PIN and CSO Partners.
- Ensure PIN’s Partnership strategy and Localization approach is strongly adhered for implementation of Country programme strategy and projects.

**Programme Management:**

- Ensure effective leadership and management of PIN Myanmar programme through line management of Programme / Area Managers or Project Managers where relevant.
- Lead donor proposal design, development and writing processes from a programme perspective and coordinate with other departments and strives for financial stability and the diversification of financial resources.
- Ensure timely and high-quality reporting is done by all programmes to donors and to HQ as relevant.
- Ensure project developed meets high standards in terms of design, implementation and M&E through proper Project Cycle Management.
- Prepare programme budgets collaboratively with programme and finance staff and in accordance to donor budget guidelines.
- Track programme expenditure through monthly programme review meetings using financial expenditure reports prepared by the finance department.
- Ensure compliance to donor policies, procedures and procurement.
- Ensures that the Emergency preparedness planning (EPP) is conducted/reviewed and the action plan is fulfilled in coordination with CD, Senior managers and HQ colleagues.

**Representation & External Relations**

**Human Resource Management:**

- In consultation with the Country Director, plan HR needs, capacity building needs for senior program staff and ensure sufficient human resources for the programme to meet its objectives.
- Ensure coherent policy towards recruitment, remuneration and bonuses across the country programme.
- Ensures that the capacity development of national staff is properly managed and financed and that PIN internal resources support it.

**Representation, Communications & Networking:**

- Ensure that PIN is well represented and visible in the donor community, amount key partners, and within coordination fora, delegating as appropriate to programme staff.
- Ensure PIN maintains its position within existing sectors and with its existing strengths especially with regards to field presence, and regional expertise.
- Share responsibilities with Country Director for donor representation and discussions about funding opportunities.
- Builds partnerships with relevant organizations or entities and seeks for a synergy effect with relevant stakeholders.
- Engage in advocacy and policy dialogues where appropriate, ensuring PIN represents the needs of its beneficiaries and based on its field experience in order to campaign for needed policies, donor commitments etc.

**Quality and Risk Management:**

- Ensures that procedures described in PIN policies, including the Safeguarding Policy, are in place and functional with programme and projects implementation.
- Ensures MEAL (Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning) related procedures and functions are in place with CRFM mechanisms being implemented across programme and projects.
- Ensure project risk assessments while recommending project proposals, contracts and payments according to given thresholds and coordinates the risk mitigation measure.

**Documentation and Learning:**

- Ensure that all programmes properly retain programme learning for future projects, and that all information is properly documented.
- Ensure that all official programme documentation is properly stored and available for the future.

## **Main requirements:**

- Higher-education degree (Bachelor’s or Master’s) in a relevant field
- Proven experience in humanitarian programming, including project cycle management, team leadership, needs assessments, and proposal development
- Experience in a senior management role such as Head of Programmes or Programmes Director
- Strong understanding of quality standards in humanitarian programming, including safeguarding and accountability mechanisms, with proven experience implementing them in practice
- Knowledge and experience in Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) within projects
- Excellent people management and team leadership skills
- Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to plan effectively, transfer knowledge, and work collaboratively in multicultural environments
- Excellent spoken and written English
- Dynamic, result-oriented, and systematic approach to work
- Strong critical analysis and problem-solving skills
- Ability to work effectively under pressure and in difficult conditions
- Cultural sensitivity and adaptability
- Contextual experience in Myanmar is considered an asset/preference

## **We offer:**

- Working environment in a well-established humanitarian organization in a challenging context;
- **Salary & Benefits**: Salary based on PIN’s salary scale and HR policies; expected salary range between 3250 - 3500 EUR super gross (based on experience).
- **Additional allowances include**:
    - Monthly Subsistence Allowance of 1395 EUR;
        - Accommodation arranged by PIN;
- **Time off and Rest:**
    - 25 days of holiday annually;
        - 10 sick days.
- **Travel benefits:**
    - Reimbursement of travel expenses with travel to the country of residence once every 6 months of work;
        - Reimbursement of costs of visas and vaccinations; assistance with the visa application procedure;
        - Reimbursement for the medical check-up before and after the deployment;
        - Travel health insurance covering medical care, incl. the repatriation.
- **Health and Well-being:**
    - 24/7 Medical Support available online;
        - Free psychological consultations available online;
- **Professional Development:** Free access to e-learning platforms and PIN Learning Hub; PIN’s global Induction Training, and tailored capacity-building opportunities.

National candidates are welcome to apply. Employment terms for the national staff differ and will be shared upon request.

jobs.body:
**Job Title:** GBV and Gender Equality Technical Advisor

**Location:** Erbil, Kurdistan Region, Iraq (KRI), with occasional travel to other areas of KRI.

**Type of position:** Employment contract/ Expat or National Contract

**Length of Contract:** 12 Months

**Compensation and Benefits:** Competitive salary and benefits commensurate with skills and experience. Local/Expatriate Compensation Package: includes relocation expenses and housing and local transportation allowances

**About SEED:** SEED is a women-led, local NGO in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq, dedicated to creating a thriving society by advancing social protection and human development. We support individuals, empower communities, and strengthen systems to drive lasting change and equal opportunity. With a focus on collaboration, we promote gender equality, protect children, combat human trafficking, and improve mental health and well-being. SEED’s holistic, locally-driven approach integrates transformational services, community development, training and education, and advocacy to create sustainable impact. SEED is committed to creating a just, equitable society where everyone's rights are protected, with healthy families and strong communities, and a future where everyone can thrive.

**Role of the GBV and Gender Equality Technical Advisor:**

The technical advisor is responsible for the technical leadership, strategic direction, and operationalization of the community-based psychosocial support and community-based initiatives within their pillar. S/he actively drives the pillar’s progress by aligning strategy and objectives with community-specific needs. Working with program and project managers across SEED, they apply their thematic expertise to lead intervention design and planning, and support implementation of group and community activities. They ensure that all psychosocial support and community development activities are technically sound, culturally appropriate, and effectively designed to meet SEED’s strategic goal of engaging and empowering communities.

Core functions include creating or updating curricula and materials for community and group-based activities; training and equipping staff to deliver the curricula, and providing ongoing technical support to staff; creating robust MEAL systems to review impact and community feedback; and supporting program teams to implement the engagements.

This position will lead the ***Combating Gender-Based Violence and Promoting Gender Equality*** thematic pillar.This pillar focuses on reducing violence against women and girls; strengthening women’s leadership, participation, and representation; and engaging men and boys as allies in preventing violence and promoting gender equality. Through prevention, awareness, and rights-based empowerment approaches, SEED works to shift harmful norms and strengthen women’s role in families, institutions, and communities.

**Specific Tasks:**

***Technical Leadership, Program Planning and Design, and Innovation (40%)***

- Serve as the technical authority for the thematic pillar, providing technical and programmatic leadership for the design and implementation of all associated curricula and implementation standards.
- Translate SEED’s broad strategic goals and objectives into actionable interventions and engagements.
- Serve as the primary technical advisor for cross-unit initiatives for this pillar integrating best practices into all organizational programs and strategies.
- Lead the creation of SOPs, policies, and guidance documents regarding PSS implementation, community engagement, and accountability standards for this pillar.
- Collaborate closely with other technical advisors to synchronize strategies, share best practices, and co-design technical tools that drive the unit’s objectives.
- Work closely with program managers to bridge the gap between technical design and operational feasibility/implementation.
- Regularly assess the product portfolio to identify opportunities for new implementations or expansion into new geographic areas.
- Lead the design and development of new tools, curricula, facilitator manual, and programmatic materials tailored to community needs, ensuring survivor-centred and trauma-informed approaches are maintained across all pertinent interventions
- Ensure all technical products are culturally sensitive, contextually relevant, and consistent with SEED’s strategic objective.
- Provide data-driven basis for program planning and design through technical reports and briefs that reflect the progress and challenges of the thematic pillar.

***Capacity Building and Technical Supervision (30%)***

- In close collaboration with other Technical Advisors, as well as pertinent colleagues from external departments, lead on ensuring PSS Staff Onboarding Package is updated, relevant and fit for purpose.
- Coordinate with the PSS & Community Development Unit to ensure all PSS Staff (coordinators, facilitators, mobilisers and other staff as requested) have been properly onboarded, and refresher support is provided as required.
- Provide technical advice to support program development and implementation to ensure maximum impact and consistency to program/project managers and Program Development and Management Unit.
- Lead or support (as appropriate) the development and revision of PSS Curricula, including the creation of all materials, facilitator manuals and training materials
- Ensure PSS Staff are fully trained and equipped to deliver SEED’s thematic curricula with high quality, through direct provision of training, Training of Trainers, and support to dedicated trainers as appropriate.
- Contribute to the development / refinement of tools and guidance for coaching and technical supervision to PSS Staff.
- Provide / support in the provision of regular technical supervision and coaching, to maintain staff well-being, high-quality session delivery and consistency across the pillar to support PSS Staff in the field.

***Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability, and Learning (20%)***

- Support in the review and revision of SEED Standard Indicators aligned with this pillar, including articulating and defining indicators, and identifying / developing appropriate means of verification for their measurement, and support as necessary in results analysis
- Collaborate closely with MEAL to conduct comprehensive community needs assessments and ensure all findings directly shape program planning and design.
- Contribute to / lead on (as appropriate) the design and implementation of monitoring and evaluation (M&E) frameworks and data collection tools to rigorously track the progress, outcomes, and long-term impact of the pillar’s interventions.
- Ensure all pillar activities are systematically monitored, documented, evaluated, and reported to maintain high standards for data integrity and technical accountability, ensuring accountability to affected populations / program participants at all stages.
- Support the synthesis and analysis of insights with PSS Staff to refine programs and strengthen future programs
- Monitor the effectiveness of training materials in partnership with MEAL using field observations and PSS team facilitation experiences to continuously improve technical resources.
- Lead regular technical learning sessions to disseminate compiled results and synthesized data from pillar-level activities to the wider team contributing to organizational knowledge.
- Maintain learning and feedback mechanisms to continuously refine technical products based on real-time field data, community shifts, and changes in internationally recognized minimum standards.
- Support the safe and meaningful participation of women, girls, men and boys program participants at all stages of the program cycle..

***Communication, Coordination, and Representation (10%)***

- Produce high-quality reports, policy briefs, presentations, and multimedia content focused on SEED’s work with a specific emphasis on both pillar and community development initiatives.
- Support the development of programmatic materials tailored for diverse stakeholders to raise awareness and promote SEED’s mission.
- Write and review articles, social media posts, and website content to ensure technical accuracy and alignment with SEED’s strategic goals.
- Provide technical input for all promotional materials and ensure all public-facing content adheres to SEED’s Storytelling Policy.
- Represent SEED in relevant forums, conferences, and working groups; share insights on interventions and approaches to advocate for the organization’s goals with key stakeholders.

**Essential Criteria:**

*Education and Experience*

- Required: Bachelor’s degree in Gender/Women’s Studies, Psychology, Social Work, International Development, Human Rights, Public Health, or a related field with at least 5 years of progressive experience in technical leadership or advisory roles.
- Preferred: Master’s degree in a relevant field with at least 3 years of experience in a technical leadership capacity.
- Proven experience in the humanitarian or development sector, with a specific technical focus on GBV prevention and response, gender equality, and women’s empowerment.
- Demonstrated experience in strategic program design and providing technical supervision to multi-disciplinary teams.
- A proven track record of building staff capacity through the design and delivery of training, coaching, and mentorship.
- Proven track record of supporting and partnering with government and non-government agencies, with the ability to communicate effectively on sensitive topics

*Technical Expertise*

- Deep technical knowledge of GBV prevention and response, social norm change, and rights-based programming; experience engaging men and boys as allies is a strong asset.
- Expert-level experience in curriculum development and creating culturally sensitive tools (SOPs, guidance notes, and training manuals).
- Strong background in psychosocial support and community development; experience in social cohesion and social and behavioral change initiatives is an asset.
- Proficiency in designing MEAL frameworks, conducting needs assessments, and utilizing data to refine technical interventions.

*Context and Skills*

- Experience working in humanitarian and/or development settings is a must; specific experience in the Middle East, particularly Iraq or the Kurdistan Region, is a significant asset.
- Exceptional written and verbal English skills are required; proficiency in Kurdish (Sorani) and/or Arabic is highly desirable.
- Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace and other digital tools.
- Deep commitment to SEED’s mission, values, and ethical standards, including a strong understanding of “Do No Harm” principles.
- Demonstrated commitment to gender equality and inclusive programming.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Specialist (Remote) | Proposals and Documents
jobs.body:
Altamont Group is a boutique advisory focused on supporting the humanitarian, government, and development sectors across emerging and emerged economies. Our team has over 45 years of expertise in:  
• Monitoring, Evaluation, Research and Learning (MERL)  
• Strategy and Policy  
• eLearning/Capacity Development/Training  
• Quality Assurance and Accreditation  
• Organizational Optimization  
By leveraging global best practices within local contexts and prioritizing quality, access, and value; we drive sustainable impact and long-term success, as well as deliver innovative, tailored solutions, for our global clients.

**Role Description**  
Altamont Group (AG) is seeking an experienced Quality Assurance Specialist (QAS) to support our team. This role is crucial in ensuring the quality and accuracy of our proposals, and client deliverables, i.e., reports, PPTs, proposals, social media verbiage, website updates, etc. The successful candidate will review content, format, and style to ensure all documents align with client requirements and AG standards. The ideal candidate will work closely with proposal and project teams to maintain high standards across all stages of proposal development and project implementation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Quality Assurance (QA) for Proposals:**

- Fully understand the key requirements of the Terms of Reference (TOR) and the client’s requirements for proposals
- Review proposals to ensure compliance with all RFP/TOR requirements, ensuring all necessary sections are included and formatting guidelines are adhered to
- Ensure key messages and technical language are clear, concise, and consistent throughout the proposal
- Review proposal documents for grammatical errors, clarity, consistency, and validate financial figures, technical content, and data accuracy
- Ensure the technical approach, methodology, and work plan are logical, feasible, and clearly articulated
- Follow the steps/processes laid out in the Proposal Daily Progress Sheet and meet proposal deadlines
- Promptly address any revisions required to ensure proposals meet quality standards and client expectations

**Quality Assurance (QA) for Documents/Deliverables:**

- Conduct comprehensive reviews of client deliverables, e.g., evaluation reports, research reports, etc. to ensure alignment with client requirements and AG quality standards
- Edit documents, including reports, and presentations, to ensure content is aligned with client requirements and documents have correct grammar, spelling, and formatting, as well as are consistent
- Validate the accuracy and relevance of data, figures, and references in reports and proposals
- Identify discrepancies, inconsistencies, or areas of improvement in deliverables and coordinate with project teams to address them
- Ensure all client deliverables meet expectations in terms of quality, timeliness, and alignment with project objectives
- Proactively address potential quality issues to mitigate client dissatisfaction or rework
- Ensure all deliverables align with AG’s protocols, standards, templates, and branding guidelines

**Quality Assurance (QA) for Social Media Content:**

- Review and revise social media verbiage
- Review and revise website verbiage
- Review social media posts to ensure clarity, consistency, and adherence to AG’s branding and tone of voice
- Ensure all social media content aligns with AG’s communication strategy and engagement goals
- Verify factual accuracy, grammar, spelling, and formatting in social media captions, posts, and other digital content
- Collaborate with content creators and the social media team to enhance message effectiveness and audience engagement

**Quality Assurance (QA) Process Improvement:**

- Develop and refine quality assurance processes to ensure efficiency and consistency
- Implement best practices for reviewing and approving documents, reports, and proposals

**Required Skills and Experiences**

- Bachelor’s degree in English, Business, Research, Quality Management, or a related field
- Proven experience in the humanitarian/development sectors
- Expertise with document development and review with exceptional attention to detail
- Strong knowledge of quality assurance principles and methodologies, particularly for proposal and document development
- Ability to analyze and validate data, ensuring accuracy and consistency
- Familiarity with research and evaluation processes
- Strong organizational and time-management skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team
- Proficient in MS Office, SharePoint, and project management software
- Strong attention to detail
- Ability to prioritize tasks and work under pressure
- Ability to manage deadlines efficiently
- Exceptional Western English writing/editing abilities
- Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
- Flexible attitude toward receiving feedback

**What's in it for You**

- **Professional Growth:** Enhance your expertise and skill set while gaining valuable practical experience in quality assurance and project management within a supportive team environment.
- **Meaningful Impact:** Feel the satisfaction of being part of a team that makes a difference globally with impactful work.
- **Collaborative Environment:** Work closely with teams to improve content quality.
- **Opportunity for Advancement:** Grow skills through diverse projects and continuous learning.
- **Relationship Management:** Facilitate client communication and team collaboration.
- **Flexibility and Support:** Enjoy remote work flexibility with team support.
- **Valued Input:** Experience the empowerment of knowing that your input is not only welcomed but highly valued and respected.
- **Recognition:** Contributions are valued and acknowledged, fostering pride in your work.

jobs.title: Tupande Area Coordinator - Nyanza
jobs.body:
## About One Acre Fund

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions. To learn more, please see our [Why Work Here](https://oneacrefund.org/careers/why-work-here) blog post.

Our Kenya program, founded in 2006, operates under the local brand Tupande. Close to 500 staff in our Kakamega headquarters support 1,747 field staff and serve more than 1 million farmers. In Nairobi, around 50 staff support global functions like procurement, recruitment, government relations, and communications.

Looking for a strategic leader to act as the entrepreneurial architect of their territory, leading a team to scale retail impact and drive revenue through data-driven execution in a rapidly growing, mission-led organization.

- Provide leadership and coaching to sales representatives to ensure they are meeting performance targets
- Build and maintain relationships with key customers and stakeholders in your assigned area
- Participate in target setting, sales forecasting and budgeting processes
- Continuously develop knowledge of the industry and stay up to date on market trends and competitor activity

## Career Growth and Development

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

## Qualifications

Across all roles, these are the [general qualifications we look for](https://oneacrefund.org/work-with-us/application-process/qualifications/). For this role specifically, you will have:

- Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or related field preferred
- Proven experience in sales management, preferably in a related industry
- Excellent leadership and communication skills
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Ability to motivate and coach a team to achieve sales targets
- Results-driven with a passion for achieving goals and exceeding expectations

## Preferred Start Date

As soon as possible

## Job Location

Nyanza, Kenya

## Benefits

Health insurance, paid time off

## Eligibility

This role is only open to citizens or permanent residents of Kenya.

## Application Deadline

03 November 2026. Please note that we hire on a rolling basis which means that applications are reviewed and processed on a continuous basis until a hire is made.

*One Acre Fund never asks candidates to pay any money or pay for tests at any stage of the interview process. Official One Acre Fund emails will always arrive from an @*[*oneacrefund.org*](http://oneacrefund.org/) *address. Please report any suspicious communication here (globalhotline@oneacrefund.org), **but do not send applications or application materials to this email address.***

*Diversity, Equity, Inclusion (DEI), and anti-racism are deeply connected to our organization’s mission and purpose. One Acre Fund aspires to build a culture where all staff feel consistently valued, represented, and connected – so that our team can thrive as professionals, and achieve exceptional impact for the farmers we serve.*

jobs.title: Grants and Compliance Coordinator (Syria - Damascus )
jobs.body:
**Job Title: Grants and Compliance Coordinator**

**Job Location: Syria - Damascus**

**Report to: Country Representative**

**Job Style : Full-Time**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Grants and Compliance Coordinator supports the effective management of UITYD’s Syria grant portfolio by ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant donor reporting; maintaining complete grant records and trackers; coordinating donor communications; and verifying that programmatic, financial, procurement, and contractual actions are aligned with approved donor agreements, budgets, policies, and applicable regulations. The role places particular emphasis on grants funded by United Nations agencies and other institutional donors, including preparation and follow-up of FACE forms and supporting documentation, expenditure tracking, reporting calendars, and compliance checks throughout the grant lifecycle.

**MAIN DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

The Grants and Compliance Coordinator has the following responsibilities and duties:

***Grant Management and Donor Reporting:***

- Maintain a comprehensive grants portfolio tracker covering agreements, amendments, budgets, reporting schedules, payment tranches, key deliverables, donor conditions, and close-out requirements.
- Coordinate the preparation, consolidation, quality review, and timely submission of narrative, financial, and other donor reports in line with contractual requirements.
- Lead the preparation, review, and tracking of UN Harmonized Approach to Cash Transfers (HACT) documentation, including Funding Authorization and Certificate of Expenditures (FACE) forms, supporting schedules, and required evidence.
- Establish and maintain reporting calendars, send advance reminders to responsible departments, and follow up until inputs and approvals are complete.
- Review donor reports for consistency across narrative achievements, indicator results, expenditure figures, workplans, budgets, and supporting documentation.
- Coordinate responses to donor comments, clarification requests, spot checks, audits, verification exercises, and monitoring findings.
- Support grant start-up, implementation reviews, amendments, no-cost extensions, budget revisions, and grant close-out processes.

***Financial Tracking and Grant Compliance:***

- Track expenditures against approved budgets in coordination with Finance and program budget holders, using budget-versus-actual reports and other grant monitoring tools.
- Identify underspending, overspending, ineligible costs, budget variances, and delayed expenditure posting; promptly escalate risks and propose corrective actions.
- Verify that expenditures are charged to the correct project, budget line, period, and donor-approved category.
- Ensure financial supporting documents required for donor reporting, reimbursement, liquidation, and verification are complete, consistent, and readily retrievable.
- Support reconciliation of advances, donor installments, receivables, and grant balances, including timely follow-up on pending financial actions.
- Maintain an up-to-date matrix of donor rules, cost eligibility requirements, reporting templates, procurement thresholds, visibility obligations, and documentation standards.

***Contract, Procurement, and Operational Compliance Review**:*

- Review contracts, memoranda of understanding, sub-awards, partnership documents, purchase requests (PRs), procurement plans, and related operational documents to confirm alignment with donor agreements and approved budgets.
- Confirm that requested goods, services, quantities, specifications, delivery periods, procurement methods, and budget codes are eligible and consistent with approved project documents.
- Check compliance with donor-specific procurement conditions, competitive bidding requirements, authorization levels, sanctions requirements, branding/visibility rules, and record-retention obligations.
- Document compliance observations and required corrective actions clearly before commitments are made or documents are approved.
- Coordinate with Supply Chain, Finance, Programs, HR, and Operations to resolve compliance gaps while avoiding unnecessary delays to project delivery.
- Support due diligence and compliance review of implementing partners, vendors, consultants, and other third parties, as applicable.

***Donor Relations and Coordination:***

- Serve as a focal point for routine grant-related communication with donors, particularly UN agencies, under the direction of the Country Director.
- Prepare professional correspondence, meeting briefs, donor updates, action trackers, and follow-up notes.
- Participate in donor meetings, grant reviews, kick-off meetings, monitoring visits, and close-out discussions; record decisions and ensure agreed actions are completed.
- Support the development and review of concept notes, proposals, budgets, logframes, and donor applications when requested.
- Promote clear, timely, and consistent communication between UITYD Syria, headquarters, donors, and implementation partners.

***Documentation, Risk Management, and Capacity Building:***

- Maintain complete, organized, and audit-ready electronic grant files, with appropriate version control and secure access for online collaboration.
- Monitor grant risks and compliance issues, maintain action logs, and escalate material concerns to the Country Director and relevant technical leads.
- Track donor recommendations, audit findings, management actions, and deadlines through closure.
- Develop practical checklists, templates, and guidance notes to strengthen grant compliance across departments.
- Provide orientation and coaching to project and support teams on donor requirements, FACE forms, reporting responsibilities, documentation standards, and grant controls.
- Contribute to continuous improvement of UITYD’s grants management systems, workflows, and internal coordination.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS**

Should have the following skills, education, and experience:

*Educational Qualification*

- Bachelor’s degree in business administration, finance, accounting, international development, law, public administration, or a related field.
- A relevant master’s degree is an advantage.

*1. Experience*

- At least three years of relevant experience in grants management, donor compliance, financial monitoring, program operations, or institutional donor reporting within an NGO or humanitarian organization.
- Demonstrated experience with UN agencies or other institutional donors; practical experience preparing or reviewing FACE forms is strongly preferred.
- Experience reviewing donor agreements, budgets, procurement documentation, contracts, purchase requests, and supporting financial records.
- Experience supporting audits, spot checks, donor monitoring, grant amendments, and close-out processes.
- Experience in the Syria humanitarian or recovery context is strongly preferred.

*2. Technical Skills*

- Strong understanding of grant-cycle management, donor compliance, cost eligibility, internal controls, and documentation requirements.
- Strong analytical ability, with close attention to financial figures, deadlines, contractual conditions, and inconsistencies across documents.
- Excellent organization, follow-up, and record-management skills across multiple grants and competing deadlines.
- Strong written and spoken English and Arabic, including the ability to draft professional donor correspondence and reports.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and online collaboration platforms; ability to work effectively in a remote or hybrid environment.
- High integrity, discretion, accountability, and commitment to humanitarian principles.
- Ability to communicate diplomatically, coordinate across departments, and raise compliance concerns constructively.
- Ability to work under pressure, prioritize effectively, and deliver accurate work with limited supervision.

**ABOUT UITYD**

UITYD is a global humanitarian organization providing medical and health services to people in need. With administrative operations based in Gaziantep, UITYD oversees comprehensive humanitarian and operational programs that extend across all regions of Syria.

**CODE OF CONDUCT** The Code of Conduct reflects the profession's core set of beliefs and values of care, respect, trust, and integrity. The postholder must comply with UITYD’s Code of Conduct and all applicable policies, including safeguarding, prevention of sexual exploitation and abuse, child protection, anti-fraud and anti-corruption, conflict of interest, confidentiality, data protection, sanctions compliance, and whistleblowing.

**CHILD PROTECTION POLICY** Child abuse in all forms is unacceptable, and the organization recognizes its responsibility to protect children from harm in all areas of its work. The organization is committed to ensuring a child-safe environment and is applying a zero-tolerance approach towards any kind of child abuse and exploitation.

**DISCRIMINATION, ABUSE AND HARASSMENT POLICY** The organization provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and expressly prohibits and will not tolerate any form of discrimination, abuse, harassment (sexual or otherwise). Any suspected violation must be reported through the appropriate UITYD channels.

**Safeguarding & Code of Conduct** All employees must adhere to protection policies, principles, and rules of conduct. Strict compliance with safety and ethical standards is required. Employment is subject to UITYD policies, applicable law, satisfactory references, and required screening and verification.

MC works with humanitarian and development organizations across several countries in the region, including Sudan.

MC is expanding its roster of qualified field personnel who may be engaged for upcoming research, monitoring, evaluation, and data-collection assignments across the country.

jobs.title: PIN Asia Representative
jobs.body:
**Duty Station:** Bangkok, Thailand; no remote option  
**Line Manager:** Business Development Lead  
**Contract length:** 3+ years with initial one year contract

People in Need (PIN) is a Czech-based international non-governmental organization (NGO) that has provided humanitarian and development assistance across more than 20 countries since 1992. Today, PIN stands as one of the largest organizations of its kind in Central and Eastern Europe, supporting vulnerable communities in Asia, Africa, the Middle East, and Eastern Europe. PIN empowers civil society, advocates for human rights, and promotes social inclusion both in the Czech Republic and abroad.

**Position Summary:**

People in Need (PIN) is seeking a highly connected, entrepreneurial and strategic Asia Representative to expand our engagement with institutional donors, foundations, philanthropies and influential stakeholders across Asia and the Pacific.

This is a unique opportunity for a senior business development and external relations professional who thrives on building partnerships, opening doors, and translating relationships into meaningful impact for vulnerable communities worldwide.

As PIN's representative in the region, you will play a pivotal role in positioning the organisation with key donors and partners, identifying new funding opportunities, and strengthening PIN's visibility and reputation across Asia and the Pacific.

## **About the role:**

The Asia Representative will serve as PIN's strategic ambassador to donors, foundations, development finance institutions and other influential stakeholders in the region. Working closely with regional and headquarters leadership, you will help shape and deliver our donor engagement strategy, establish new partnerships, and support the growth of PIN's humanitarian and development portfolio.

This is a highly external-facing role requiring strong networking skills, donor intelligence, strategic thinking and the ability to engage confidently with senior decision-makers.

## **Duties & Responsibilities:**

### **Drive Strategic Donor Engagement**

- Lead PIN's positioning and relationship-building efforts with donors and stakeholders across Asia and the Pacific.
- Develop and implement engagement plans aligned with PIN's Regional Business Strategy and Advocacy Strategy.
- Provide strategic advice on donor trends, opportunities and positioning within the region.
- Generate donor intelligence and maintain an up-to-date network and contacts database.

### **Expand Funding Opportunities**

- Identify, develop and pursue new funding opportunities with institutional donors, foundations, philanthropies and private sector partners.
- Support the cultivation of long-term strategic partnerships that contribute to sustainable growth of PIN's programmes globally.
- Facilitate introductions and engagement between donors and PIN senior leadership, country programmes and technical teams.

### **Raise PIN's Profile in the Region**

- Represent PIN at regional conferences, donor forums, networks and strategic events.
- Position PIN as a leading humanitarian and development actor across Asia and the Pacific.
- Develop compelling presentations, capacity statements and partnership materials tailored to donor audiences.
- Promote PIN's expertise, achievements and strategic priorities to external stakeholders.

### **Strengthen Cross-Organisational Collaboration**

- Work closely with the Institutional Relations Department (IRD), Asia and other Regional Director and Deputies, Country Directors, Technical Advisory Unit and Strategic Pillar Leads.
- Collaborate with advocacy colleagues to support strategic messaging and stakeholder engagement initiatives.
- Ensure donor engagement efforts are aligned across country, regional and headquarters levels.

## **Requirements:**

**Essential**

- Significant experience in donor relations, business development, institutional fundraising, external affairs or partnership development (e.g. GCF, DFAT, ADB, JICA, KOICA, Regional branches of global foundations or regional foundations etc.)
- Established network within the development, humanitarian, philanthropic or public sector landscape in Asia.
- Demonstrated success in cultivating strategic partnerships and securing funding opportunities.
- Strong understanding of international development and humanitarian assistance architecture.
- Exceptional relationship-building, communication and representation skills.
- Ability to engage confidently with senior government, donor and foundation representatives.
- Excellent written and verbal English.

**Desired**

- Experience working with major bilateral and multilateral donors.
- Knowledge of climate finance mechanisms and development finance institutions.
- Familiarity with the Asia-Pacific philanthropic ecosystem.
- Experience working within an international NGO.

## **Asia portfolio:**

The geographic focus of the role will be on Myanmar, Nepal, the Philippines, Laos, Cambodia, Mongolia and Afghanistan—where we deliver emergency response and implement programming aimed at civil society development and building climate resilient communities and economies.

PIN provides humanitarian aid through cash assistance, food security support, shelter materials, and access to safe water and sanitation. As one of the leaders in disaster preparedness, it reinforces local disaster‑preparedness systems, enhances early‑warning mechanisms, and builds community capacity to anticipate and respond to recurring climate‑related shocks. This includes promoting risk‑informed planning, pre‑crisis triggers for early action, and measures that help households act before hazards escalate into emergencies.

In parallel, PIN implements development initiatives that improve livelihoods, expand economic opportunities, and promote inclusive access to essential services. This includes supporting farmers and small enterprises, advancing climate‑smart agricultural practices, improving nutrition, and strengthening market linkages to reduce vulnerability to climate and economic shocks. With civil society strengthening at the core of its mandate, PIN also collaborates with local partners and community institutions to foster civic engagement, strengthen accountability, and encourage locally led, resilience‑focused solutions.

PIN's programming across Asia is funded by major institutional donors such as ECHO, FCDO, DG INTPA, UNOCHA and WFP. We are also part of a dynamic network of local and international partners including Alliance 2015, Charter for change, Climate charter, Risk-Informed Early Action Partnership (REAP), Anticipation Hub, START network, Climate Action Network (CAN), World Meteorological Organisation Associated programme on flood management. In July 2026, PIN received accreditation to the Green Climate Fund (GCF).

## **PIN Offers:**

- Working environment in a well-established humanitarian organization in a challenging context;
- **Salary & Benefits**: Salary based on PIN’s salary scale and HR policies

**Additional allowances include**:

- Accommodation provided by PIN/Monthly Housing Allowance
- Family policy in place

**Time off and Rest:**

**Travel benefits:**

- Reimbursement of travel expenses with travel to the country of residence once every 6 months of work;
- Reimbursement of costs of visas and vaccinations; assistance with the visa application procedure;
- Reimbursement for the medical check-up before and after the deployment;
- Travel health insurance covering medical care, incl. the repatriation;

**Health and Well-being:**

- 24/7 Medical Support available online;
- Free psychological consultations available online;

**Professional Development:**

- Free access to e-learning platforms and PIN Learning Hub; PIN’s global Induction Training, and tailored capacity-building opportunities

jobs.title: Senior Protection Coordinator
jobs.body:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solution driven, passionate change-maker, come join us positively, impacting the lives of millions of people worldwide for a better future.

Since 2017, IRC has supported Rohingya Refugees and Bangladeshi nationalities communities in Cox's Bazar, Khulna, Barisal, and Chittagong with integrated services. The organization also addresses climate change impacts by building resilience and promoting economic recovery, education, and protection.

**Purpose of this role:**

The Sr. Protection Coordinator will lead protection programming in Cox’s Bazar. This role will provide strategic and technical leadership, ensure timely implementation of project activities, represent IRC Bangladesh in the Protection Cluster and related forums, and support business development, donor engagement, and proposal development. The role will work closely with multi-functional teams including programme, advocacy, communication, MEAL, and operations to deliver high-quality protection outcomes. The Sr. Protection Coordinator will have overall responsibility to supervise and support the Protection program teams composed of Women Protection and Empowerment (WPE), Child Protection (CP) and Protection and Rule of Law (PRoL). S/he will ensure program results delivery, quality, and impact, sustainability.

**Major Responsibilities:**

**A. Strategic Leadership and Program Management**

- Provide strategic direction and technical oversight to the organization’s protection programming in Cox’s Bazar.
- Ensure effective planning, implementation, and monitoring of protection activities in line with project ToC, goal and objectives, quality standards, organizational policies, and donor requirements.
- Lead development and execution of work plans, spending plans, procurement plans, and activity tracking to ensure timely and quality project delivery.
- Support adaptive programming by identifying implementation challenges, risks, and opportunities and proposing practical solutions.
- Ensure mainstreaming of protection principles, accountability, safeguarding, gender, inclusion, and conflict sensitivity across program implementation.
- Strengthening program quality through regular field monitoring, technical support, and mentoring of team members.

**B. Business Development and Resource Mobilization**

- Identify strategic funding opportunities aligned with the organization’s protection priorities and field realities.
- In coordination with Sr. Grants and Partnership Coordinator, contribute to business development efforts including needs analysis, concept note development, proposal writing, budget input, and donor reporting.
- Support development of high-quality program documents, research, assessments, case studies, and evidence to strengthen fundraising efforts.
- Work with Partnerships and senior management to position the organization for future protection funding opportunities.

**C. Coordination with Multi-Functional Teams**

- Ensure regular collaboration and communication with other units and functions including Health, Education, Economic Recovery and Development and other programs to ensure integrated programming components are highly functional and grounded in best practice across both sectors. .
- Facilitate integrated planning and implementation across functions to maximize program impact and operational efficiency.
- Coordinate internal review meetings, progress tracking, and action follow-up with relevant teams.
- Collaborate with Advocacy and Communications teams to develop key messages, case studies, briefing notes, and visibility materials related to protection work.
- Ensure that program evidence and learning inform advocacy priorities and communication outputs.
- Support development of external products that highlight protection concerns, project achievements, lessons learned, and community voices in a safe and ethical manner.

**D. Representation and External Engagement**

- Represent the organization in the Protection Cluster, working groups, sub-sector meetings, inter-agency coordination platforms, and other relevant forums.
- Maintain strong professional relationships with government authorities, UN agencies, NGOs, donors, community leaders, and other stakeholders.
- Actively contributes to sector discussions, technical initiatives, and coordination efforts to influence protection priorities and response strategies.
- Ensure that the organization’s position, achievements, and concerns are effectively communicated in external forums.
- Ensure IRC’s active contribution in all coordination forums at local level (sub districts and camps)

**E. Team Leadership and Capacity Building**

- Provide day-to-day technical guidance and coordination support to protection team leader; WPE Coordinator, CP Coordinator and PROL Coordinator
- Coach, train, and mentor protection team members with the aim of strengthening their technical capacity, exchanging knowledge within the team and providing professional development guidance, and ensure that capacity development plans are in place for all protection teams.
- Foster a collaborative, accountable, and inclusive team environment.
- Support recruitment, performance management, coaching, and professional development of team members where applicable.

**F. Others**

- Promote and actively participate in initiatives and efforts to build team engagement, inclusion and cohesion in IRC Bangladesh.
- Foster ongoing learning, honest dialogue and reflection to strengthen safeguarding and to promote IRC values and adherence to IRC policies.

**Major Challenges/Difficulties of this role:**

- Building the capacity of a team from the bottom up.
- ensure coordination between the implementation and technical team
- ensure that the respective Technical Coordinators, Sector Specialists and Technical Managers are providing adequate quality and technical oversight to both IRC’s and partners program
- Demonstrating strong technical leadership in coordination forums and in partnerships where other agencies may need significant technical mentorship and support to meet standards.

**Qualifications and Competences:**

- Bachelor's degree in international development, law, human rights, or a related field; a Master's degree is preferred.
- Minimum of 10 years’ professional experience in managing protection programs on humanitarian response, with specific experience in protection programming in emergency or post conflict settings, with strict security rules.
- At least 3–5 years in a senior coordination, managerial, or technical leadership role.
- Demonstrated experience in Cox’s Bazar/Rohingya response or similar complex humanitarian settings is highly preferred.
- Proven experience in Protection Cluster representation, inter-agency coordination, and stakeholder engagement.
- Strong experience in business development, including proposal writing, donor engagement, and program design.
- Experience working with multi-functional teams including advocacy, communications, MEAL, and operations.
- Demonstrated track record in managing project implementation and ensuring timely delivery against targets.

**Required Competencies and Skills**

- Strong understanding of protection principles, humanitarian architecture, coordination mechanisms, and rights-based programming.
- Excellent program management, planning, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
- Strong interpersonal and representation skills with the ability to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders.
- Excellent writing and communication skills in English.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure and meet deadlines.
- Strong leadership and team coordination skills.
- Ability to work independently while maintaining close collaboration with cross-functional teams.
- High level of integrity, professionalism, and commitment to safeguarding and protection principles.

**Duty Station and Travel:** The position will be based in **Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh** and may require regular travel to field locations within the district and other areas as required by program needs.

**Standard of Professional Conduct:**

The position will must require adhere to the values and principles outlined in the IRC Way – our Code of Conduct. These are Integrity, Service, Accountability, and Equality. In accordance with these values the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding (including PSEAH, Adult Safeguarding and Child Safeguarding), Anti workplace Harassment, Fiscal Integrity, and Anti Retaliation

jobs.title: Sewing Atelier Supervisor at Habibi.Works
jobs.body:
## **About Habibi.Works**

Habibi.Works is a solidarity-based makerspace and community hub located next to the refugee camp of Katsikas in Northern Greece. It provides access to tools, knowledge, and shared spaces for people on the move, local residents, and international volunteers.

Rooted in values of solidarity, mutual respect, and justice, the project fosters community, agency, and resilience in a context shaped by European migration policies.

## **Role Description**

Our Sewing Atelier Supervisor is responsible for managing the sewing atelier so that people have the opportunity to use the workshop and sewing machines independently, but also to gain and enhance their skills with sewing machines, textiles and tailoring. The Sewing Workshop is a heavily used working area in Habibi.Works with both very skilled tailors coming to use the space, as well as people who have no experience with sewing machines yet.

### **Primary responsibilities:**

- Make sure people use the machines correctly. If you see someone misusing a machine, offer your help; it is about education and empowerment. Show someone how to use the tools correctly and then encourage them to use the machine correctly
- Manage the material stock. Sort out material that is not needed and document if any material is missing. Communicate needs to the relevant team member and support in sourcing new materials
- Manage the even distribution of materials and adhere to our guidelines on material use per individual project (2 metres per 3 weeks)
- Support people in realizing their projects; guide people through the design and building process if needed
- Ensure the space is clean and tidy / materials are put back after use. Engage participants in this!
- Keep an eye on the machines and tools. If anything breaks, communicate this to the relevant team member to find a solution
- Ensure participants adhere to Habibi.Works’ “making, not taking” policy i.e. only completed projects can be taken home, not raw/unworked material

### **Secondary responsibilities:**

- Manage the distribution of weekly appointments for the sewing atelier; there is a dedicated appointment distribution given the demand for new fabric
- Documentation of the activities and creation of guides for various projects

### **Skills and Experience**

- Basic sewing skills, particularly pattern-making, clothing design and creation
- Knowledge of maintenance and set up of sewing machines
- (Desirable) Knowledge of embroidery, quilting and designing

## **Requirements:**

- Commitment: minimum 6 weeks
- Minimum age: 22
- Ability to live in the EU for duration of stay (we cannot support with visa processes)

## **What we offer:**

- Shared accommodation
- Meals on working days
- Two weekend days (Sunday & Monday)
- A meaningful role in a grassroots, solidarity-based project
- Possibility to extend to a long term contract after 3 months

jobs.title: Training Coordinator / Damascus
jobs.body:
**Job Purpose**

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven **Post-Training Coordinator**. Please note: this role is **NOT** focused on delivering training programs. Instead, it is dedicated entirely to the post-training phase, acting as the crucial bridge between our graduates and the job market. Your primary mission will be to advocate for our alumni, build strong corporate partnerships, attract job offers, and successfully place our graduates into meaningful employment. If you have a background in talent sourcing, recruitment, or career services and love connecting people with opportunities, this is the role for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Post Training Planning & Coordination**

- **Employer Networking & Outreach \[Employment Support\]:** Proactively reach out to local businesses, corporate partners, and hiring managers to build a network of employers willing to hire our graduates.
- **Job Offer Attraction \[Employment Support\]:** Source, negotiate, and secure exclusive job offers, internships, and apprenticeship opportunities specifically for our alumni network.
- **Talent Matching & Placement \[Employment Support\]:** Deeply understand the skills and profiles of our graduates to effectively match them with the right job vacancies and company cultures.
- **Candidate Marketing \[Employment Support\]:** Actively pitch and recommend qualified graduates directly to hiring organizations, acting as a specialized recruiter on behalf of our alumni.
- **Career Coaching & Preparation \[Employment Support\]:** Conduct mock interviews, assist with resume optimization, and provide targeted advice to ensure graduates are highly competitive in the hiring process.
- **Event Coordination \[Employment Support\]:** Organize tailored networking events, employer meet-and-greets, and boutique job fairs to directly connect graduates with prospective employers.
- **Data Management & Tracking:** Maintain an up-to-date database of alumni employment statuses, employer contacts, and available job vacancies.
- **Reporting:** Track job placement rates, retention metrics, and overall success of the post-training integration program to report back to management.

**Monitoring, Evaluation & Reporting**

- Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness and impact of training activities through observations, participant assessments, field visits, and evaluation tools.
- Collect participant feedback and identify lessons learned and recommendations for improving future training activities.
- Prepare timely training reports, field visit reports, attendance records, evaluation summaries, and other required project documentation.
- Maintain accurate databases and documentation for all training activities, participants, and capacity-building results.

**Stakeholder Coordination**

- Coordinate closely with project teams, local authorities, implementing partners, and community representatives to ensure effective implementation of training activities.
- Maintain regular communication with trainers and participants to address operational and technical issues.
- Represent the project during training events and coordination meetings as required.

**Capacity Building & Knowledge Management**

- Develop, review, and update guides, manuals, and learning materials.
- Promote knowledge sharing and continuous learning among project staff and partners.
- Support the development of innovative learning methodologies and adult learning approaches to enhance participant engagement.

**Additional Responsibilities**

- Travel regularly to project sites to supervise training activities and provide technical support.
- Ensure compliance with safeguarding policies, protection principles, organizational procedures, and donor requirements during all training activities.
- Perform any other duties assigned by the Project Manager or relevant supervisors.

**Note:** The above responsibilities are illustrative. Additional tasks may be assigned according to operational needs and organizational structure.

**Qualification (Education/Work Experience)**

**Essential**

- Bachelor’s degree in education, Human Resources, Social Sciences, Business Administration, Public Administration, or a related field.
- Minimum of three (3) years of relevant experience in coordinating, organizing, and implementing training or capacity-building programs.
- Proven experience in recruitment, talent sourcing, or corporate partnership development.
- A strong existing network of local employers, HR professionals, or business leaders is highly preferred.
- Experience in career counselling, resume building, or interview preparation.
- High level of empathy and the ability to motivate and build confidence in recent graduates entering the job market.
- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple employer relationships and candidate profiles simultaneously.
- Experience preparing training reports, monitoring documentation, and evaluation tools.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
- Fluency in Arabic and good working knowledge of English (spoken and written).

**Preferred**

- Previous experience working with NGOs or international organizations.
- Experience managing donor-funded projects.
- Knowledge of adult learning methodologies and participatory training approaches.
- Experience using digital learning platforms or Learning Management Systems (LMS).
- Training of Trainers (ToT) certification is an advantage.

**Core & Managerial Competencies**

**Core Competencies**

- Commitment to Continuous Learning
- Effective Communication
- Planning and Organization
- Teamwork and Collaboration
- Stakeholder Orientation
- Reliability and Professionalism
- Problem Solving and Adaptability

**Technical Competencies**

- CRM & Database Management: Proficiency in using Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software or Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) to manage graduate profiles, track employer interactions, and monitor placement pipelines.
- Talent Sourcing & Market Mapping: Technical ability to utilize platforms like LinkedIn, professional networking sites, to identify hiring trends and open vacancies.
- Resume & ATS Optimization: Deep understanding of modern Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) to effectively coach graduates on formatting resumes and digital profiles (like LinkedIn) to pass automated corporate screenings.
- B2B Lead Generation & Outreach: Familiarity with professional email outreach, pipeline management, or sales engagement tools to systematically identify, contact, and secure new corporate hiring partners.
- Data Tracking & Reporting: Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets to accurately track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) such as placement rates, time-to-hire, and graduate retention, as well as the ability to generate clear performance reports for management.
- Field monitoring and supervision
- Training monitoring and evaluation
- Report writing and documentation
- Event and logistics management
- Knowledge management and learning systems
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and digital collaboration tools

jobs.title: Head of Systems and Operations for DR Congo
jobs.body:

**Starting date:** Upon agreement

**Line Manager:** Country Director

**People in Need** (PIN) is a Czech-based international non-governmental organization (NGO) that has provided humanitarian and development assistance across more than 20 countries since 1992. Today, PIN stands as one of the largest organizations of its kind in Central and Eastern Europe, supporting vulnerable communities in Asia, Africa, the Middle East, and Eastern Europe. PIN empowers civil society, advocates for human rights, and promotes social inclusion both in the Czech Republic and abroad.

## **About the DR Congo Programme of People in Need:**

PIN is active in DRC since 2008. PIN focuses on addressing humanitarian and development needs, particularly in conflict-affected areas of South Kivu. PIN has provided emergency support in nutrition, food security, WASH, agriculture, and cash assistance while promoting climate resilience through sustainable initiatives, and is currently expanding its portfolio to include Education in Emergencies. Supported by donors such as ECHO, UN OCHA, and DoS, PIN operates with a small but solid team of national staff, reaching vulnerable communities in remote and hard-to-access areas.

## **About the role:**

The Head of Systems & Operations (HoSO) is a core member of the Country Management Team (CMT) for People in Need’s DRC mission and jointly ensures the effective, efficient and accountable management of the entire DRC Country Programme (CP) and shares responsibility for the effective and efficient delivery.

The HoSO is responsible for strategically leading and continuously improving all key support functions — **Procurement & Logistics**, **Finance**, **Human Resources**, and **Administration**. In performing this role, the Head of Systems & Operations will ensure an enabling environment for the implementation of CP, while maintaining operations and systems that meet the accountability requirements of People in Need and its donors.

HoSO also directly leads the process of development and staff capacity building across the departments in terms of systems and operations.

## **Main Duties & Responsibilities:**

- Strategic leadership
- Quality and risk management
- Management of Human Resources and capacity development
- Finance management

- Ensuring external and internal compliance

## **Main requirements:**

- Excellent communication skills, including fluent spoken and written English, and working level of French
- Significant previous experience with managing systems, particularly logistics

- Experienced in managing teams
- Ability to coordinate and communicate clearly with different groups of people and to respect different cultural backgrounds
- Ability to work independently and effectively
- Ability to deal with a complex compliance agenda
- Analytical skills and systematic approach
- Responsibility, ownership, proactive approach, flexibility
- Experience with project management is welcome
